notes: I added the E4 knots (dense near the center, including x=±0.5, ±1.5, ±2.5, ±3, ±4, ±6, ±7, ±8, ±12, ±15, ±25) and switched to smoothstep interpolation so the curve is smooth rather than piecewise-linear, matching the observed smooth curvature. I also added linear extrapolation beyond the knot range instead of clamping, which better reflects the continuing tail slopes.
